facing: +Z (front bumper with the cyan strip; rear strip is red)
hierarchy: amr > body > {light_strip, lift_top, wheel_L, wheel_R, caster_FL > caster_wheel_FL, caster_FR > ..., caster_RL > ..., caster_RR > ...}

rig.drive: differential: spin wheel_L / wheel_R about local X (r=0.075 m); turn in place by spinning them opposite
rig.casters: caster_* swivel about local Y (origin on the swivel axis, 0.02 m trail); caster_wheel_* spin about local X (r=0.03 m)
rig.lift_top: translate +Y 0..0.06 m to lift a pod; rotate about Y to counter-rotate the pod while the robot spins
rig.light_strip: emissive (amr_led_cyan front/sides, amr_led_red rear); set toneMapped=false and pulse emissiveIntensity
